title: NWIS Model Output Schema
description: Standard schema for individual model outputs in the NWIS intelligence layer.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the processed record.

well_id.description: Canonical identifier for the well, preserved exactly from the upstream source.

data_origin.description: Provenance of the telemetry being scored. Models must not mix origins in memory.

status.description: Execution status of the model for this record.

score.description: The primary numeric score produced by the model (e.g., anomaly score, deviation, distance).

label.description: A categorized string label (e.g., 'ANOMALOUS', 'NORMAL', 'STATE_0'). Must not be a physical event name.

confidence.description: Confidence of the model's prediction [0.0 - 1.0]. Reduced by low feature coverage.

feature_coverage.description: The fraction of the required features that were available and valid for this prediction [0.0 - 1.0].

evidence.description: Machine-readable evidence explaining the model result.

feature.description: Name of the feature from the fixed registry.

contribution.description: Fractional contribution or relative distance metric indicating why this feature is cited.

direction.description: Optional string describing the feature deviation (e.g., 'HIGH', 'LOW', 'ABNORMAL').

source_row_index.description: Optional index tracing back to the raw CSV/telemetry row, if available.
